UPDATE – SERVICE RESTORATION IN PROGRESS (EAST BANK DEMERARA)
 Guyana Power and Light Inc. (GPL) wishes to advise that electricity supply has been restored to customers from Garden of Eden to Sarah Johanna.
 Customers from Sarah Johanna to Timehri and Long Creek remain affected following the earlier distribution feeder going offline.
 GPL’s technical teams continue to work to restore electricity supply to all remaining affected customers as quickly and safely as possible.
 GPL apologises for the continued inconvenience and thanks customers for their patience and understanding.

title: SERVICE INTERRUPTION ADVISORY Dear Customers, Guyana Power and Light Inc. (GPL) wishes to advise customers in Section A...
text:
SERVICE INTERRUPTION ADVISORY
 Dear Customers,
 Guyana Power and Light Inc. (GPL) wishes to advise customers in Section A Grove and Diamond, Coverden New Scheme, Grove, Farm, and Herstelling New Scheme that they are currently experiencing a service interruption due to damage to the electricity network caused by a vehicular accident along the Mocha Access Road.
 GPL's technical teams are en route to the location to assess the damage and undertake the necessary corrective works to restore electricity supply as quickly and safely as possible.
 An investigation has also commenced to identify and locate the driver and vehicle involved in the incident.
 GPL sincerely apologises for the inconvenience caused and thanks customers for their patience and understanding. Further updates will be provided as more information becomes available.
